items.stem: In ServiceNow HRSD, what does a Center of Excellence (COE) primarily represent?

options.text: A grouping that owns a set of HR services and the cases raised against them
options.rationale: Correct: a COE (e.g. Benefits, Payroll) owns related HR services and their cases.

options.text: A single employee's HR profile record
options.rationale: An HR profile is one employee's data, not a service-owning grouping.
COE is an HRSD organisational concept, not infrastructure.
A COE is not a knowledge article; it owns services and cases.

items.explanation: Correct: a COE (e.g. Benefits, Payroll) owns related HR services and their cases.

items.stem: An employee submits an HR request through Employee Center. Which ServiceNow object most directly captures and tracks the work to fulfil it?

options.rationale: Correct: HR requests are tracked and fulfilled as HR cases.
The CMDB tracks IT assets, not HR request fulfilment.
Change requests manage IT changes, not HR service delivery.
HRSD uses HR cases, not ITSM incidents, for HR requests.

items.explanation: Correct: HR requests are tracked and fulfilled as HR cases.

items.stem: Select TWO ServiceNow capabilities that help keep sensitive HR case information confidential.

options.text: HR-specific security/ACL configuration restricting who can read HR records
options.rationale: Correct: HR security and ACLs restrict access to sensitive HR data.

options.text: Marking HR cases and documents as confidential/restricted to the HR role
options.rationale: Correct: confidentiality settings limit visibility of sensitive HR cases and documents.

options.text: Publishing all HR knowledge articles to every employee by default
options.rationale: Broad publishing reduces rather than protects confidentiality.

options.text: Disabling all logging on HR records
options.rationale: Disabling logging harms auditability and is not a confidentiality control.

options.text: Granting the admin role to every fulfiller

items.explanation: Correct: HR security and ACLs restrict access to sensitive HR data.
